content.short: Rango is a cross-chain DEX and bridge aggregator routing swaps across many networks.
content.description: Rango is a cross-chain DEX and bridge aggregator covering Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Monad and more than fifty other networks. Integrators embed it as a customisable widget or call the API and SDK, and MetaMask is among the wallets routing through it. Gasless swaps are available on Solana and EVM chains, so a user can act without holding the native token. Its action layer executes swaps, payments, lending, staking, limit orders, DCA and NFT purchases from a single intent, which wallets, dapps and AI agents use for cross-chain deposits.
